business_summary: BGT Group Co., Ltd. focuses on industrial water treatment, salt wastewater resource reuse, and comprehensive development of salt lakes and mineral resources in China. The company is involved in salinity water resource utilization, industrial wastewater treatment, lithium extraction from salt lakes and comprehensive mineral developments. It also offers raw water treatment, recycled water treatment, desalination, chemical water treatment systems, boiler make-up water treatment, condensate treatment, wastewater treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, industrial park wastewater treatment, and other industrial wastewater treatment. In addition, it is involved in membrane application technology, project execution, performance data, and project experience gained from industrial salinity wastewater zero liquid discharge and salt separation projects, tailored solutions combining membrane-based processes with adsorption methods for various salt lake water qualities that enable the extraction and utilization of other valuable elements within the salt lake, such as potassium, rubidium, cesium, and boron, thereby achieving comprehensive salt lake resource utilization. Further, the company offers activated coke for water purification, activated coke for wastewater treatment, and integrates adsorption, desulfurization, and purification functionalities that are used in purification of toxic and harmful gases, waste gas treatment, purification of industrial wastewater and domestic sewage, and solvent recovery. BGT Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Beijing, China.
